verdict.rationale: Workspace APIs are clearly endpoint-versioned (directory_v1, Sheets v4), and release notes record dated deprecations, turndowns and migration guides. That is practiced deprecation, not a committed policy: the standalone deprecation-policy page is labeled legacy and names no Workspace service, and the API terms allow discontinuing APIs at any time. missing for 10: a documented Workspace-specific deprecation policy with a committed notice window, and independent or hands-on corroboration of deprecation handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
